name: SF: Onee-san☆Teacher
original_name: エスエフ おねえさん☆てぃ～ちゃ～
source:
Akira was struggling with his exams, when an older and busty private instructor, Lumina, came into his life.
His sister like childhood friend also gets involved in his daily routine, of studying and love and sex.
What waits ahead... and a surprising turn of events for the 3 of them?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE016859.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
阿基拉（Akira）正在为考试而苦苦挣扎，这时一位年长、丰满的私人教练卢米娜（Lumina）走进了他的生活。
他像儿时朋友一样的妹妹也参与了他的日常生活，包括学习、爱情和性。
前方等待着什么……他们三人的事件又会发生怎样的惊人转折？
